description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Total' extension controller for the admin panel in OpenCart. It manages installation, uninstallation, and listing of total extensions, including handling permissions and extension registration.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'total' extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that outputs the list of total extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of available and installed total extensions for display.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a total extension, including registration and permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a total extension, including permission management.
